description: Contract for a Developer ACK (A developer -> evidence of consuming a Supervisor Order). See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5. The hand-written validator in src/protocol/validate-ack.mjs is the authoritative enforcement.

ack_id.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex over the canonicalized ACK fields (see src/protocol/order-id.mjs computeAckId).

comment_url.description: GitHub URL of the ACK comment as read back from the server.

created_at.description: Metadata only; the GitHub comment server metadata is authoritative.

decision_received.description: Decision the ACK claims to have received. Must match the referenced Order's decision.

executed.description: What A actually did. Empty when refused/deferred.

new_head_sha.description: New commit after A acted; null when nothing was committed.

observed_head_sha.description: HEAD A observed when consuming the Order.

order_id.description: The Supervisor Order this ACK responds to.

refusal_reason.description: Required when decision_received is STALE_ORDER or BLOCKED and nothing was executed.

title: AI Supervisor ACK v1
